part_functions.name: Peripheral framing
part_functions.function: Forms a continuous rounded rectangular frame around a large central opening, suitable for bordering, spacing, protecting, or retaining a panel-like component.

part_functions.name: Edge protection
part_functions.function: Rounded inner and outer transitions remove sharp edges and distribute contact loads around the perimeter.

part_functions.name: Panel interface
part_functions.function: The opposed annular faces and continuous aperture wall provide broad seating and alignment interfaces for an adjacent panel, cover, seal, or enclosure.

section_functions.name: Front seating flange
section_functions.function: Provides the principal broad, continuous front-facing contact surface around the opening and connects the inner aperture boundary to the outer perimeter.

section_functions.name: Load distribution
section_functions.function: Spreads perimeter contact loads through the planar ring while the adjacent fillets reduce local stress concentration.

feature_functions.name: Aperture-edge fillet
feature_functions.function: Joins the front annular face to the inner aperture wall with a continuous 2 mm-radius transition, protecting the opening edge and reducing stress concentration.
